model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the training loss over iterations for several models, including a Vanilla model and various versions of SepLLM and StrmLLM. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," ranges from 0 to 140,000 with major tick marks at intervals of 20,000, representing the number of training iterations. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," ranges from 2.4 to 3.4, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.1, representing the loss value. The plot shows that all models start with a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a rapid decrease in loss in the initial iterations. The "Vanilla" model (purple line) shows a steady decline, ending at a loss of approximately 2.5. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" (blue line) and "SepLLM (n=64)" (orange line) models show similar trends, with the loss decreasing to around 2.6. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" (green line) and "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" (red line) models also follow a similar pattern, with losses converging to approximately 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=128)" (dark blue line) model shows a slightly different trajectory, with a loss that decreases to around 2.55. All models show a general trend of decreasing loss over iterations, with the loss values stabilizing after approximately 100,000 iterations.
